task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an exciting round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! First, it would be a great idea if you could attempt to venture west. That done, make an attempt to move north. If you can get through with that, travel east. Okay, and then, head east. That done, move south. And then, doublecheck that the portal is wide open. After you have pulled open the portal, attempt to go south. Then, assure that the hatch is wide open. And then, take a trip south. And then, lift the passkey from the floor of the playroom. That's it!
